  "title": "Digital Marketing Lead",
  "description": "Worknigeria was established with a Singular Vision. To help the vast Nigerian workforce find meaningful jobs. We are also on a mission to upskill them in the best ways possible and help them grow with and within their careers.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Digital Marketing Lead

Job Location: Iyana Ipaja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time, On-site
Work Hours: Monday &ndash; Friday, 10:00 AM &ndash; 7:00 PM

Role Overview


	We are seeking an experienced Digital Marketing Lead to drive the organization&rsquo;s digital demand generation, customer acquisition, and marketing automation initiatives.
	The role will oversee the full digital customer journey, from website engagement and lead generation to qualification, nurturing, conversion, and acquisition.


Key Responsibilities
Digital Experience, SEO &amp; Conversion:


	Optimize websites, landing pages, forms, chat experiences, and conversion paths to improve lead generation and conversion.
	Conduct regular SEO, UX, CRO, website performance, and conversion audits.
	Work with web developers to implement website improvements, tracking, personalization, and progressive data capture.
	Monitor website performance and identify opportunities to improve user engagement and conversion rates.


Lead Generation &amp; Marketing Automation:


	Develop and manage multi-channel demand generation campaigns across paid search, paid social, display, email, and retargeting.
	Build automated lead nurturing, segmentation, scoring, and qualification workflows.
	Implement lead routing and response processes using CRM and automation platforms.
	Maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified leads and improve marketing-to-sales conversion.


CRM, MarTech &amp; Revenue Operations:


	Manage and optimize CRM, marketing automation, website, advertising, analytics, and reporting platforms.
	Integrate marketing technology systems to improve data flow, attribution, automation, and reporting.
	Maintain data quality, governance, and accurate tracking across marketing channels.
	Evaluate and implement relevant AI and automation tools to improve marketing efficiency.


Analytics &amp; Performance Reporting:


	Track and analyze key metrics including CTR, CPC, CPL, conversion rate, ROAS, website traffic, lead quality, and acquisition cost.
	Analyze the performance of digital campaigns, landing pages, and the overall marketing funnel.
	Provide end-to-end attribution and identify channels and campaigns driving qualified opportunities.
	Develop dashboards and performance reports for management decision-making.


Qualifications &amp; Experience


	Bachelor&rsquo;s Degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Business Analytics, Communications, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
	3-5 years of hands-on experience in digital marketing, demand generation, growth marketing, marketing operations, or a similar role.
	Proven experience implementing and optimizing CRM, MarTech, marketing automation, and analytics systems.
	Demonstrated success improving website conversion rates, lead quality, customer acquisition, and marketing ROI.
	Strong understanding of B2B digital marketing and demand generation; experience within construction, engineering, facility management, manufacturing, industrial, or related sectors is an advantage.
	Strong analytical, project management, communication, and problem-solving skills.
	Proximity to work location is highly desirable.
	Willingness to work fully on-site in Iyana-Ipaja, Lagos, Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM &ndash; 7:00 PM


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: careers@worknigeria.com using the Job Position as the subject of the email.",

Customer Support / Sales Onboarding Agent Job at Mwanga Limited




        
    

        
        Mwanga is a pioneer tech-driven debt recovery and business support outsourcing company with a vision to be the leading extension to global teams in Africa. We started our pilot operations in 2018 with a small agile team and have scaled impressively since then in results and team becoming trusted by key players for recoveries in Nigeria. We offer business support to businesses with the aim of helping them scale using ethical and innovative technology strategies. We are trusted by Africa’s leading lenders to recover their outstanding debts and to scale our impact. We provide a range of services ranging from debt recovery, telemarketing, call center outsourcing, virtual assistant services, customer support services, and data analysis.
     

            
    



We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Customer Support / Sales Onboarding Agent

Job Location: Maryland, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time (Onsite)
Work Schedule: 24/7 operation (Rotational shifts, including weekends and public holidays)

Job Summary


	We are seeking smart, customer-focused Customer Support / Sales Onboarding Agents to engage customers at the point of sale and onboard them onto products they have purchased.
	The role requires clear communication, product knowledge, and the ability to guide customers smoothly through onboarding while delivering an excellent customer experience.
	This position operates in a fast-paced, call center environment and is ideal for individuals who are confident, persuasive, and service-oriented.


Key Responsibilities


	Engage customers via calls or other approved channels.
	Educate customers on the product they have purchased and guide them through the onboarding process.
	Clearly explain product features, benefits, and usage to customers.
	Resolve basic customer inquiries and escalate complex issues appropriately.
	Ensure accurate capture and documentation of customer information.
	Meet daily and weekly onboarding, quality, and productivity targets.
	Adhere strictly to call scripts, onboarding procedures, and compliance guidelines.
	Deliver a professional and positive customer experience at all times.
	Work collaboratively with Team Leads and QA to improve performance and service quality.


Requirements / Qualifications / Skills


	Candidates should possess an OND / HND / B.Sc. qualification with 0-3 years of experience
	Previous experience in customer service, call center, sales is an added advantage
	Good verbal communication, interpersonal skills, Quick to learn new products and processes and customer-focused.
	Strong typing skills with high speed and accuracy for efficient data entry and customer interaction.
	Fluency in English and any other local language i.e Hausa, Igbo or Yoruba is an added advantage.
	Basic computer literacy and ability to use CRM or call systems
	Can work 24-hour rotational shifts, including weekends and public holidays.
	Must reside in Maryland, Lagos or nearby environs

  "description": "Expro Group is a global energy services company, delivering innovative, sustainable well solutions with a focus on safety, data, and performance

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Subsea Operations Co-Ordinator

Job Location: Port Harcourt, Rivers
Employment Type: Full-time
Reports to: Country Manager

About The Role


	We are seeking an experienced and highly organized Subsea Operations Coordinator to support the planning, coordination, and execution of subsea operations.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring the timely mobilization of personnel, equipment, materials, and logistics while maintaining compliance with company procedures, client requirements, and industry standards.
	This role requires a strong operational background within the subsea and offshore oil and gas industry, excellent stakeholder management skills, and the ability to effectively coordinate multiple activities in a fast-paced environment.


Key Responsibilities


	Coordinate personnel, equipment, materials, and logistics to support safe and efficient subsea operations.
	Liaise with clients to determine operational requirements and ensure timely mobilization of resources in line with project schedules.
	Serve as the primary interface between clients, offshore personnel, vendors, and internal departments.
	Advise clients on operational and equipment limitations and recommend practical alternative solutions where necessary.
	Ensure all subsea equipment is properly maintained, inspected, certified, and fit for purpose prior to deployment.
	Plan manpower requirements and coordinate personnel mobilization to meet operational demands.
	Support the recruitment and deployment of permanent and contract personnel as required.
	Coordinate third-party equipment, service providers, and subcontractors to ensure seamless operational execution.
	Monitor manpower, equipment, and project-related costs to ensure adherence to approved budgets.
	Ensure operational records, timesheets, certification documents, and project reports are accurately maintained.
	Support the invoicing process through the timely submission of operational and cost documentation.
	Prepare and submit operational reports and updates to management and clients.
	Participate in an on-call rotation to support 24-hour operational coverage when required.
	Ensure compliance with company HSE policies, client requirements, and industry regulations.
	Promote continuous improvement and operational excellence across all activities.


Requirements
Education:


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree or Higher National Diploma (HND) in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Marine Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, or a related discipline.
	Professional certification in Project Management, Offshore Operations, or a related field will be an added advantage


Experience:


	Minimum of 6 years of experience in the subsea, offshore, or oil and gas industry.
	Significant field, wellsite, offshore, or subsea operational experience.
	Proven experience in an operations coordination, logistics coordination, project support, or supervisory role.
	Experience managing subsea equipment mobilization, offshore logistics, and resource planning.
	Demonstrated experience interfacing with clients, contractors, subcontractors, and multidisciplinary teams.
	Previous experience in a coordination role and previous experience in project coordination.


Travel Requirements:


	The role is based in Port Harcourt and will require frequent travel to offshore locations, client sites, operational bases, and project locations within Nigeria and, where necessary, internationally.
	The successful candidate must be willing and medically fit to travel offshore and undertake offshore assignments as required


Technical Competencies:


	Strong understanding of subsea operations, offshore logistics, and equipment management.
	Knowledge of subsea equipment certification, maintenance, and mobilization requirements.
	Experience with project planning, operational reporting, budgeting, and cost control processes.
	Good understanding of HSE standards and offshore industry best practices.
	Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and operational interfaces effectively.


Personal Attributes:


	Strong organizational and coordination skills.
	Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
	Ability to work under pressure and manage competing priorities.
	Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
	Leadership capability with the ability to influence and motivate teams.
	Commitment to safety, quality, and operational excellence.


What We Offer


	Competitive remuneration package.
	Opportunity to work on challenging and high-impact subsea projects.
	Professional development and career growth opportunities.
	Dynamic and collaborative working environment.
	Exposure to local and international offshore operations.


Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and relevant certifications to: Nigeria.HR@expro.com and copy Stakeholder.recruitment@ncdmb.gov.ng&nbsp;&nbsp;using &quot;Subsea Operations Coordinator - Port Harcourt&quot; as the subject of the email.

MEP Project Engineer Job at Mar&Mor Integrated Services Limited




        
    

        
        
     

            
    

MAR&MOR is a building services company that is passionate about customer satisfaction, best practices and standards compliance. We provide semi-last mile services to improve nearly every aspect of your mechanical and electrical installations. We Design, Procure, install and maintain Heating, Ventilation and Air Conditioning (HVAC) systems, water treatment, Firefighting and water supply systems as well as power supply, electrical network and communication systems to meet industrial, commercial or residential requirements. We also provide quality general plumbing services. Over the years, we have gained outstanding experience delivering quality service to a wide range of discerning clients, gathering a considerable knowledge base working on projects, with a solid team of engineers and technicians with an average of 10 years experiential practice - committed to providing products and services of the highest quality.

Today, we offer these resources and experience to help you lower maintenance and repair cost; reduce downtime and improve productivity; increase operating efficiency and achieve a better return on assets. Established in 2008, MAR&MOR continues to grow, with a strong reputation for delivering high quality, fully integrated electrical and mechanical installations. The Key: we have always understood the need to provide better services at competitive prices. We place so much emphasis on continuous process improvement and are poised to reach quality levels that set new standards in the industry. Our primary goal is to deliver best practices and a comfortable environment for our clients.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: MEP Project Engineer

Job Location: Abuja (FCT) 
Employment Type: Full-time

Description


	We are hiring Project Engineers to oversee mechanical inspections, troubleshooting, and evaluations of MEPF installations on building projects.
	You will work closely with the Project Manager to manage both technical and financial aspects, ensuring project success while maintaining strong relationships with clients and stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities


	Plan, manage, and execute installations in line with project specifications, standards, and timelines.
	Ensure seamless integration of MEPF systems with architectural and structural designs.
	Assist in developing project schedules, budgets, and resource allocation plans.
	Conduct inspections and evaluations to ensure compliance with technical drawings, design specifications, and quality standards.
	Troubleshoot technical issues on-site and provide engineering solutions.
	Prepare working and As-Built drawings reflecting executed installations.
	Represent MAR & MOR in client and consultant meetings, providing updates on project progress.
	Coordinate with subcontractors, suppliers, and vendors to ensure timely and quality-compliant materials/services.
	Maintain accurate project records, including technical documents, inspection reports, and material submittals.
	Prepare and submit progress reports, highlighting milestones, challenges, and solutions.
	Assist with the preparation of handover documentation, including the Operation and Maintenance Manual.
	Provide technical guidance, support, and training to site personnel.
	Lead and motivate teams for excellence in execution.


Requirements


	BSc, B.Tech / HND, or M.Sc Degree (or equivalent) in Mechanical / Electrical Engineering.
	Minimum of 5 years of post-NYSC experience in MEP building services.
	Previous site experience

title: Job Openings at BorederlessHR
content:
BorederlessHR is a tech firm based in canada. They partner with different businesses in North America to recruit top tech African talent for available roles on a full time basis.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below:

1.) Lubricants Sales Executive (Automotive)

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role
     

            
    




	On behalf of a client, we are seeking an experienced and results-oriented Lubricants Sales Executive (Automotive) to drive the growth of our automotive lubricants business across the open market in Lagos.
	The ideal candidate will have a strong background in automotive lubricants or related industries, with proven experience in distributor management, market expansion, and Route-to-Market (RTM) execution.
	This role requires a commercially minded sales professional who thrives in a competitive environment and has a passion for building customer relationships and delivering measurable business growth.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve revenue and market share targets for automotive lubricants.
	Identify, recruit, onboard, and manage distributors, dealers, wholesalers, and other channel partners.
	Execute effective Route-to-Market (RTM) strategies to improve product availability and market coverage.
	Expand existing territories while identifying and developing new business opportunities.
	Build and maintain strong relationships with distributors, retailers, mechanics, transport operators, and other key industry stakeholders.
	Conduct regular market visits to monitor competitor activities, customer trends, pricing, and market opportunities.
	Support distributors and channel partners with sales initiatives and business development activities to achieve agreed sales targets.
	Collaborate with the marketing team to plan and execute promotional campaigns, trade activations, exhibitions, and customer engagement events.
	Prepare accurate sales forecasts, market reports, and performance updates for management.
	Work closely with logistics and supply chain teams to ensure timely product availability and efficient order fulfilment.
	Education
	Bachelor's Degree or HND in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related discipline.


Experience


	Minimum of 4 years of experience in sales and distribution within any of the following industries:
	Automotive Lubricants
	Automotive
	Auto Parts
	Auto Care
	Industrial Products
	Demonstrated success in distributor development, market expansion, and RTM execution.
	Proven experience introducing and growing new products within the open market.


Required Skills:


	Strong understanding of automotive lubricants, sales channels, and open market distribution.
	Excellent relationship management and stakeholder engagement skills.
	Strong negotiation, communication, and presentation abilities.
	Sound knowledge of sales forecasting, reporting, and territory management.
	Ability to work collaboratively across sales, marketing, and logistics teams.
	Good analytical and problem-solving skills with a results-driven mindset.


Ideal Candidate Profile:
We are looking for someone who is:


	Commercially driven and passionate about achieving sales targets.
	Street-smart, proactive, and able to identify new business opportunities.
	Self-motivated and capable of working independently with minimal supervision.
	Resilient, adaptable, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, competitive environment.
	Customer-focused with strong business acumen and excellent interpersonal skills.


Salary
N370,000 – N500,000 Gross Monthly.

Application Closing Date: 14th September, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their resume to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

 

2.) Investment and Funds Mobilization Manager

Job Location: Victoria Island, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Reports To: Managing Director
Workmode: Hybrid

Description


	On behalf of our client, we are seeking a results-driven Investment Funds and Mobilisation Manager to join our team.
	The ideal candidate will be responsible for sourcing funds from individuals and corporate clients, promoting investment products, and building strong investor relationships.
	You will play a key role in driving liquidity by mobilizing funds and supporting a financial institution that provides solutions such as working capital, contract finance, lease finance, invoice discounting, personal loans, bridge finance, import duty finance, and loan syndication.


Key Responsibilities
Funds Mobilization & Business Development:


	Mobilize funds from individual and corporate clients to meet liquidity needs
	Identify and develop new markets and funding sources
	Drive continuous growth of the client base and investment portfolio
	Execute cold calling, warm calling, and client acquisition strategies.


Client Relationship Management:


	Build and maintain strong relationships with investors
	Manage client portfolios to ensure retention and repeat investments
	Provide tailored investment solutions aligned with client needs.


Investment & Portfolio Support:


	Recommend profitable investment opportunities for excess liquidity
	Ensure diversification of funding sources to reduce risk
	Monitor market trends and provide insights for investment decisions


Reporting & Stakeholder Engagement:


	Communicate effectively with internal stakeholders and management
	Provide regular updates on fund mobilization performance
	Prepare reports and presentations for decision-making.


Requirements
Education:


	Bachelor’s Degree in any discipline
	Master’s degree or professional certification is an added advantage.


Experience:


	3 – 7 years of must have experience in treasury or Investment
	Proven track record in fund mobilization, client acquisition, and treasury product sales
	Experience with cold calling, business development, and client retention.


Key Skills & Competencies:


	Strong understanding of financial products and treasury instruments
	Knowledge of fund mobilization strategies
	Investment analysis and portfolio diversification skills
	Strong sales and business development ability
	Excellent communication and negotiation skills
	Relationship management and stakeholder engagement
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook)
	Results-driven with strong target achievement orientation.


Ideal Candidate Profile:


	Commercially focused and target-driven
	Confident, persuasive, and client-facing
	Strong networking and investor access capability
	Resilient and comfortable with business development pressure
	Professional, credible, and trustworthy
	Self-motivated with strong ownership and accountability.


Salary
N500,000 - N1,500,000 monthly (Net) + Benefits

Application Closing Date: 25th September, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their resume to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

 

 

3.) Official Driver

Job Location: Gbagada, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Working Days: Monday to Friday
Resumption: Immediately if possible

Description


	We are seeking a reliable, professional, and experienced driver to provide safe and efficient transportation for the  Sales Manager during official business activities.
	The driver will support the Sales Manager with daily movements, client visits, sales meetings, field trips, and other official assignments. The successful candidate must be punctual, discreet, well-organized, and familiar with major routes within Lagos.


Key Responsibilities


	Provide safe and timely transportation for the Sales Manager.
	Drive the Sales Manager to client meetings, sales appointments, business events, and official engagements.
	Plan routes and monitor traffic to ensure timely arrival at appointments.
	Maintain the vehicle in a clean, safe, and presentable condition.
	Conduct routine checks on the vehicle and report maintenance issues promptly.
	Ensure the vehicle is properly fueled and ready for daily assignments.
	Assist with carrying or transporting sales materials, documents, samples, or equipment when required.
	Remain available and flexible during the Sales Manager's official schedule.
	Maintain strict confidentiality regarding business discussions, client information, and company activities.
	Keep accurate records of trips, mileage, fuel, and vehicle maintenance where required.
	Observe all road safety regulations and company driving policies.
	Represent the company professionally when interacting with clients, vendors, and members of the public.
	Perform other driving-related duties assigned by the Sales Manager or management.


Requirements


	Valid Nigerian driver's licence.
	Minimum of 5 years of professional driving experience.
	Previous experience driving for an executive, manager, business owner, or corporate organization is an advantage.
	Excellent knowledge of Lagos roads and major business locations.
	Good knowledge of alternative routes and ability to navigate heavy traffic.
	Clean and responsible driving record.
	Ability to use Google Maps and other navigation applications.
	Good communication and interpersonal skills.
	Strong punctuality and time-management skills.
	Ability to work flexible hours when business schedules require.
	Neat, presentable, respectful, and professional appearance.
	Ability to maintain confidentiality.
	Preferred Location: Gbagada, Oshodi, Bariga, Shomolu, Anthony, Maryland and environs.


Benefits


	Pay: 150,000 net per month
	Other Benefits: Pension, HMO and Free company's products.


Application Closing Date: 9th September, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.
